ICS 59.080.30TXD 08Revised Standard from Last Update.1. Scope1.1 This standard prescribes constructional particulars and other requirements of sponge cloth, cotton khadi, grey.1.2 This standard does not specify the general appearance, feel, shade, etc.2. ReferencesThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
